jobs.description:

J53550

SAP S4 HANA BRIM

Dallas, TX
* Duration:


10 Months \+ Extension
* Domain Exposure:


Retail
* Work Authorization:


US Citizen,Green Card,OPT\-EAD,CPT,H\-1B,H4\-EAD,L2\-EAD,GC\-EAD

To Be Discussed Later
* Employment Type:


W\-2, 1099, C2C


  
### **Job Summary:**


Our client is seeking an accomplished SAP S4 HANA BRIM Consultant on a remote 6\+ months renewable contract opportunity on the East Coast..
  

Role – SAP S4 HANA BRIM Consultant  

  



* Provide L2/L3 functional support for SAP BRIM (incidents, service requests, problems, changes) aligned to ITIL/AMS governance.
* Perform triage and root cause analysis for billing, charging, invoicing, subscription, and receivables\-related issues.
* Support and configure end\-to\-end BRIM processes
* Primarily Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Subscription Order Management (SOM) including subscription lifecycle management
* Convergent Charging (CC) for usage\-based and recurring charging scenarios.
* Convergent Invoicing (CI) including billable item processing, invoicing, and bill generation.
* Contract Accounting and Receivables Management (FI\-CA) including collections, disputes, payment allocation, and account maintenance.
* Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Revenue and order\-to\-cash processing integration with SAP S/4HANA.
* Manage minor enhancements and configuration changes including pricing, charging plans, invoicing rules, business partner setup, account determination, and collections processes.
* Support monitoring and controls including billing jobs, invoicing runs, charging processes, interface monitoring, reconciliation activities, and operational KPIs.
* Troubleshoot integration issues across BRIM, S/4HANA Finance, SAP SD, SAP BTP, middleware, and external subscription platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders, finance teams, customer service teams, and IT teams to refine requirements, prioritize backlog, and deliver continuous improvements.
* Support release management activities including impact assessments, regression testing, UAT support, deployment validation, and hypercare.
* Maintain support artifacts including runbooks, SOPs, process flows, functional specifications, knowledge articles, and KT documentation.

**Technical and Delivery Skills:**
* Ability to translate business and production support issues into actionable requirements for technical teams (ABAP, Fiori, Integration, BTP, APIs).
* Experience with BRIM batch job monitoring, interface troubleshooting, reconciliation processes, and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting testing activities including SIT, UAT, and regression testing.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a fast\-paced support environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting SLA commitments.

**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of SAP experience with significant experience in SAP BRIM.
* Experience supporting SAP BRIM in production and AMS environments.
* Strong understanding of billing, subscription, finance, and revenue management processes.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA environments.

**Highly Desired Skills:**
* SAP BRIM certification.
* Experience with SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).
* Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, APIs, and event\-driven integrations.
* Exposure to subscription\-based business models, healthcare, life sciences, telecommunications, or high\-tech industries.
* Knowledge of cloud subscription management and digital commerce platforms.
* ITIL certification.
  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

  

We are an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship/ immigration status, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Santa Clara, California, United States of America Accounting Ref ID: JR\-023709  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


Job Summary
  

Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager, Revenue and Quote to Cash (QTC) Transformation to join our finance, accounting, and operations organization.


Our finance, accounting, and operations groups support business infrastructure, automation, building solutions, and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our stakeholders. Your efforts will directly impact the ongoing transformation and success of a world\-leading cybersecurity business.


You’ll lead key optimization work streams within complex business, financial, and technology problems. You possess a unique blend of business knowledge, a deep understanding of the end\-to\-end QTC process and related systems, importance of data integrity, completeness and accuracy, coupled with a focused transformation mindset.

  

  

This is a visible role with significant cross\-functional interaction within and beyond finance organization. As a key driver of execution, it’s critical that you possess strong leadership and communication skills, and the confidence and adaptability to manage stakeholders to advance practical, strategic, and quality decision\-making, and achieve our desired business outcomes.

* Support and drive the evaluation of current QTC processes and systems to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement within assigned scope areas.

jobs.title: Senior SAP Analyst - Commerical
jobs.description:
**About KARL STORZ**
 From the operating room to surgery centers—and everywhere in between—KARL STORZ North America is a global leader in medical technology and advanced visualization solutions. We design specialty innovations, smart instruments and devices, integrated ecosystems, and intelligent imaging—to build a more connected, software\-enabled operating room.
   

  

 As an independent, family\-owned MedTech company, we ambitiously think in generations instead of quarters to improve patients’ lives around the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior SAP Analyst, Commercial serves as a senior functional expert responsible for supporting, enhancing, and transforming commercial business processes within the SAP S/4HANA environment. This role partners closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to design and deliver scalable solutions supporting order management, billing, revenue management, contracts, service operations, and other commercial processes.
   

  

 The position is responsible for the full solution lifecycle, including business process analysis, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and production support. The successful candidate will help drive adoption of SAP best practices, enable new business capabilities, and support the organization's ongoing SAP modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.
   

  

**This role has a hybrid work schedule – ideally in our El Segundo, CA office, also open to working out of the Stafford, TX or Auburn, MA office** 
 .
   

  

 The compensation range for this role is: CA: $137,200 \- $178,400 and outside of CA: $113,800 \- $148,100
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Serve as the functional subject matter expert for SAP commercial solutions supporting Order\-to\-Cash, contract management, billing, revenue management, returns, and service processes.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify process improvements, and develop scalable SAP solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Lead business workshops, perform fit\-gap analysis, document requirements, and create functional specifications and solution designs.
* Configure and support SAP S/4HANA commercial solutions while collaborating with developers and integration teams to deliver business functionality.
* Participate in all phases of project delivery including requirements gathering, blueprinting, design, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Support business transformation initiatives by leveraging SAP standard capabilities and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to design solutions supporting evolving commercial and service business models.
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 production support, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions for recurring issues.
* Support integrations between SAP and other enterprise applications and external business partners.
* Maintain process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, and training materials.
* Stay current with SAP product roadmaps, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to recommend continuous improvements.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, customer\-focused work environment.


**What You’ll Bring**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or equivalent
* 8\+ years of SAP experience with strong functional expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA commercial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of end\-to\-end business processes including Order\-to\-Cash, Contract Management, Billing, Revenue Management, Returns Processing, and Service Management.
* Hands\-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and related commercial solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as Advanced Returns Management (ARM), Condition Contract Management (CCM), Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), FSCM Credit Management, and SAP Fiori applications.
* Experience gathering business requirements, conducting fit\-gap analysis, developing process blueprints, and creating functional specifications.
* Proven experience delivering projects through the full solution lifecycle including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong integration knowledge across SAP modules including FI, CO, MM, Logistics, Service, and Revenue Management processes.
* Experience with SAP integration technologies including IDocs, EDI, APIs, and SAP Cloud Integration solutions.
* Ability to read and debug ABAP code and effectively collaborate with development teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while delivering high\-quality solutions.


**Preferred:**
* 10\+ years of experience supporting SAP S/4HANA transformation, modernization, or cloud migration initiatives.
* Experience with subscription management, recurring revenue, usage\-based billing, and software commercialization business models.
* Experience with SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM).
* Experience implementing or supporting SAP S/4HANA Service Management solutions.
* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and modern SAP extensibility approaches.
* Knowledge of SAP Embedded Analytics, CDS Views, and analytical Fiori applications.
* Experience integrating SAP with CRM, tax, ecommerce, customer portal, and other enterprise applications.
* SAP certifications in SAP S/4HANA Sales, BRIM, Revenue Accounting and Reporting, Service Management, Integration Suite, or related SAP disciplines.
* Experience in medical devices, healthcare, manufacturing, software, or other regulated industries.

 Ability to travel up to 20% domestically and occasionally overseas

jobs.title: SAP FICA Enterprise Application Consultant
jobs.description:
Infosys is seeking an SAP FICA Enterprise Application Consultant
  

  

As an SAP FICA Enterprise Application consultant, you will be a key player in the consulting team that helps discover and define the problem statement, evaluates the solution options, and makes recommendations. You will plan the activities of configuration, configure the product as per the design, conduct conference room pilots and will assist in resolving any queries related to requirements and solution design. You will conduct solution/product demonstrations, POC/Proof of Technology workshops and prepare effort estimates which suit the customer budgetary requirements and are in line with organization’s financial guidelines. You will also support knowledge transfer with the objective of providing value\-adding consulting solutions that enable our clients to meet the changing needs of the global landscape.  

  

**Basic Qualifications**  

Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.  

At least 11 years of experience with Information Technology.  

Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer\-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

Experience in SAP CR\&B implementation programs in at least one of the modules of ISU FICA  

Experience across Electricity (preferred), or Gas or Water Utilities industries, North America  

Experience of at least 1 end to end lifecycle implementation activities including:  

Requirement gathering  

Business process design  

SAP configuration  

RICEFW Functional design  

Systems and Integration Testing  

Resolving production issues  

Experience in setup of Org Structure, GL setup \& Integration  

Experience in Cash journal, Clearing Control, Account Assignment and Setup of Direct Debit Payments.  

Strong Understanding of Dunning Process, Collection, Installment Plan.  

Setup of Main \& Sub transaction Experience in analyzing issue in Billing \& Invoicing process.  

Good Experience in Invoice Layout \& Bill Print.  

  

This job may entail extensive travel. The job may also entail sitting as well as working at a computer for extended periods of time. Candidates should be able to effectively communicate by telephone, email or face to face.
  

  

Estimated annual compensation range for this role will be as follows:
  

In CA, WA, NY, CO, MD, IL, MN, NJ : $116700 to $150000

jobs.title: SAP IS-U Billing Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced
 **SAP IS\-U Billing Senior Consultant,** 
 you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Talent Model. Project Talent Model (PTM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery.
   

  

**Work You'll Do/Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross\-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.
   

  

* Provide strategic and in\-depth research, analysis, and recommendations related to Customer Service business processes, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Billing processes and transactions, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
* Act as a liaison between the business area and technical support organizations to ensure business needs are properly documented and translated into technical requirements.
* Support business process analysis, procedure development, workflow optimization, issue resolution, testing, validation, and implementation of operational improvements.
* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.


**The Team**
 Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart\-of\-the\-business solutions.
   

  

 Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi\-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 5\+ years of SAP IS\-U Billing experience
* Experience in utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve


**Preferred**
* Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Excellent Written and Communication Skills
* Ability to deliver technical demonstrations


 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $115,000 to $155,000\.
   

  

 You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SAP SD/OTC- Principal Application Business Architect
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**About the Job You're Considering**
------------------------------------

  

Lead the global SAP Order\-to\-Cash (OTC) function, driving process transformation, solution strategy, and operational excellence. Partner with business, IT, and external stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions, strengthen compliance, optimize cash flow, and support enterprise\-wide digital transformation. Provide strategic leadership across complex SAP transformation programs, guide cross\-functional teams, oversee solution delivery, and establish governance to align OTC capabilities with business objectives and industry best practices.

  

Application Business Architects are responsible for leading the transformation of a business and ensuring critical deliverables, such as business capability models, business capabilities, and value streams, are developed and implemented. Provides a point of view to clients on meeting their business requirements utilizing Package/SaaS software solutions. This role has a leading role in understanding client business needs, and ability map those to the application functionalities “ ensure seamless functionality delivery of the application being developed. What is critical is to ensure that the application being developed matches client business needs, both stated and the unstated ones. Individual must support or lead bids, operate at director level or above in major client organizations, and master one or more businessorindustry domains. One must responsible for functional guidance over the whole project or application life cycle and leverage relationships with colleagues, partners and clients to build thought leadership and conceptualize new offerings.


**Your Role**
-------------

  

* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of SAP SD/OTC solutions across complex transformation programs.
* Translate business requirements and process objectives into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions.
* Lead solution design across sales order management, pricing, availability checks, delivery processing, billing, credit management, and customer master data.
* Provide architectural leadership across SAP S/4HANA implementations, transformations, and modernization initiatives.
* Lead requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, solution design, configuration strategy, testing, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Design integrated solutions across SAP SD, MM, FI/CO, Logistics Execution (LE), and other SAP and non\-SAP applications.
* Ensure SAP SD/OTC architecture aligns with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, and transformation roadmaps.
* Partner with senior business and IT stakeholders to define solution strategy, facilitate key design decisions, and resolve complex business and technology challenges.
* Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve automation, optimize cash flow, and strengthen end\-to\-end OTC capabilities.
* Provide functional and architectural leadership to consultants, technical teams, and cross\-functional delivery resources.
* Establish solution architecture standards, governance, and quality oversight throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Present solution architecture, transformation strategies, roadmaps, risks, and recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning activities, including scope definition, solution approach, estimation, resource planning, and proposal development.
* Mentor SAP consultants and architects while helping strengthen SAP SD/OTC capabilities across the practice.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

  

* **Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field required.**
* 12\+ years of SAP experience, with significant experience delivering SAP SD and Order\-to\-Cash solutions.
* Deep functional and solution architecture expertise across SAP SD/OTC.
